r.name: Avenue Verte London ↔ Paris
r.description: English part of Avenue Verte London ↔ Paris, an international cycle route that connects the two capital cities

r.name: Greenwich Meridian Trail
r.description: A long-distance walk that follows the line of the Prime Meridian. Inaugurated in 2009, to coincide with the 125th anniversary of the Greenwich Meridian.

r.name: Weardale Circular Walk From Chartwell
r.description: This beautiful circular walk links Chartwell and Emmetts Garden; passing through the woodland areas of Toys Hill and Hosey Common, as well as the pretty hamlet of French Street. Gentle slopes and occasional uneven terrain with steps. Potential livestock.

r.name: Over the Downs to Oxted Mill walk (SCC)
Westerham to Chartwell Trail, Chartwell
r.description: Enjoy a countryside walk through the Weald of Kent, starting in the village of Westerham and finishing at Chartwell, Winston Churchill's family home. Several hills, uneven paths, gates.

r.name: Weardale Walk From Emmetts Garden, Emmetts
r.description: This beautiful circular walk follows a hilly route through the Weald of Kent, linking Emmetts Garden with Chartwell, the home of Winston Churchill. It also passes through the Toys Hill, Hosey Common & French Street. Steps & potential livestock.

r.name: Hosey Common to Mariners Hill Loop Walk, Chartwell
r.description: Explore Mariners Hill on this steep circular, which takes in views over Chartwell & the Weald. An extension of the Westerham to Chartwell walk, this loop crosses through National Trust & Squerryes Court land, thanks to the support of the Warde family

r.name: Limpsfield Family Trail, Harewoods
r.description: This circular walk around Limpsfield takes you along paths & through wooded areas, with different landmarks & wildlife for all the family along the way. We are grateful to The Friends of Limpsfield Common for creating the trail. Slopes & uneven surfaces.

r.name: Limpsfield common and the Carpenters Arms Walk, Harewoods
r.description: This walk around Limpsfield Common takes you past farmers' fields and through ancient woodland. Halfway round, take a break at the Carpenters Arms – a traditional country pub. Paths are wide and over sandy soil.

r.name: Surrey Cycleway
r.description: Cycle route consisting of main loop plus link routes
